canonical_text: Phase II trastuzumab trial for women with metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer after prior trastuzumab. Excludes congestive heart failure and left ventricular ejection fraction below 50 percent.
Study of an antibody drug conjugate for adults with advanced HER2-positive breast carcinoma. Stable cardiac comorbidity and prior anti-HER2 therapy are permitted.
Trial of add-on glucose-lowering therapy in adults with type 2 diabetes, inadequate glycemic control on metformin, and chronic kidney disease stage 3.
Type 2 diabetes medication study for adults on metformin. Participants with chronic kidney disease stage 3 or worse are excluded.
CAR T-cell therapy for adults with relapsed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma after first-line chemoimmunotherapy.
Observation study for newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma before any chemoimmunotherapy; relapsed disease is excluded.
Randomized immunotherapy study for metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer.
Targeted therapy for unresectable BRAF-mutant melanoma in adults.
